description: Phase 1 rework (DESIGN revision 5, PLAN.md 'Phase 1 rework', safety-relevant first): hard diff ceiling 80/3000/3000 with test lines split and no per-target cap; research egress (github_user_content) and egress modes with default open and the every-mode invariants; the CR-003 token and approval core deltas 1-9 with the PR, proposal and skill decision services; the update-handler budget; the U14 redaction choke point and policy.check_text secret values; P1-4 (edit text checked before storing); round-6 NITs P1-15..P1-19; the no-exposure guard. Closes every TRACEABILITY row with status 'rework' assigned to FEAT-005. Depends on Phase 1 (approved). Plan: docs/PLAN.md (Phase 1 rework). Requirement rows: docs/TRACEABILITY.md.
steps: Item 22: Hard ceiling and size measurement (DESIGN §12.6, §9.14; rows CR4-2g, CR4-2h, CR4-2o, CR4-2d measurement part, CHAT-31, DES-AC-39, DES-FR-21). `common/config.py`: `DiffPolicy` defaults `max_files: 80`, `max_changed_lines: 3000`, new `max_test_lines: 3000`; new strict `SizePolicy` (`autonomous_max_class`, `preferred_classes`, `overrun_tolerance`, `on_overrun`, `exclude_globs`, `test_globs`; a validator rejects an `autonomous_max_class` whose bounds exceed the ceiling), `DiscoveryFilters` and `ProposalPolicy` with the §9.14 defaults; `config/policy.yaml` updated (comments kept). Remove `max_changed_lines` from `TargetDefaults`/`RepoEntry` (replaced by an optional per-repo `size_class` preference, autonomous only) and from `ResolvedTarget`; `policy.check_diff` splits gatekeeper numstat into code and test lines (`test_globs`), drops `exclude_globs`, and reports `too_many_files`, `too_many_code_lines`, `too_many_test_lines` against the ceiling only. A test enumerates every token purpose, command and API route and asserts none can write `policy.diff`. Files: `src/ossbot/common/config.py`, `config/policy.yaml`, `config/targets.yaml`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/policy.py`, `tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_policy.py`, `tests/unit/common/test_config.py`, `tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_ceiling_not_writable.py` Verify: `DEV pytest -m unit tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_policy.py tests/unit/common/test_config.py tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_ceiling_not_writable.py` green (80/3000/3000 edges, test lines never count as code, lockfiles/vendored excluded, a target value can no longer lower the ceiling).

Item 23: Research egress and egress modes (DESIGN §11.3, §11.5, §10.3; rows CR2-1a…1e, CR2-2a backend, CR2-2b, CR2-2c, CR2-6b, CR2-6c, CHAT-23, CHAT-24, P1-15, P1-18, DES-AC-33, DES-AC-34, ADR-0005). `config/egress.yaml`: category `github_user_content` (`.github.io`, `gist.github.com`, `gist.githubusercontent.com`) for `research` and host caller `hermes`; `always_denied` keeps `uploads.github.com`, `checkpoint-api.hashicorp.com`, adds `telegra.ph`, `api.telegra.ph`, `edit.telegra.ph` and `::/128` (P1-15), with a why-comment per entry; `mode_default: open`; per-mode grants (`modes: {allowlist, research, open}`) as data. `ctl/render.py` renders squid for (snapshot, mode) with assertions that fail the render if any invariant of §11.5 differs between modes (fetch/validate never `web_public`; gatekeeper/runner identical; denied_dst, IP literals, DNS identical) and that `agent-llm`/`catalog` get the same list. Control flag `egress-mode` (fail closed `allowlist`), `POST /v1/control/egress-mode` (human/operator only, audited, FYI), `ossctl egress mode <m>` (TTY confirm), root `systemd/ossbot-egress.path` + `ossbot-egress-apply.service` + `scripts/bin/ossbot-egress-apply` (re-render, reconfigure the proxy), `ossbot-firewall --check` and the watchdog compare the running squid config with the render for the current mode; doctor and `/status` show the mode. Goldens per mode; `tests/sandbox/test_profiles.py` gains the github.io/gist case (200 for research, 403 for fetch/validate/agent-llm outside `open`; uses a local fixture host when offline); `tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh` updated (hermes 3141 reaches `x.github.io.`/`gist.github.com.`; code-running profiles 403). VERIFICATION.md threat-table rows 7/36 reworded (P1-18). The Telegram `/egress` command is FEAT-009. Files: `config/egress.yaml`, `src/ossbot/common/config.py`, `src/ossbot/ctl/render.py`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/{control.py,api/control.py}`, `src/ossbot/common/control_flags.py`, `scripts/bin/{ossbot-egress-apply,ossbot-firewall}`, `systemd/ossbot-egress.{path,service}`, `scripts/lib/services.sh`, `tests/unit/ctl/{test_render.py,golden/squid.*.conf}`, `tests/sandbox/test_profiles.py`, `tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh`, `docs/VERIFICATION.md` Verify: `DEV pytest -m unit tests/unit/ctl` green for all three modes; after redeploy `ROOTDEV pytest -m sandbox` and `ROOT bash tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh` green; `ROOT /opt/ossbot/bin/ossbot-firewall --check` exits 0 in `open` and after `ossctl egress mode allowlist`. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 16: egress data and modes (CR-002 req 1, 2, 6). config/egress.yaml: move .github.io, gist.github.com, gist.githubusercontent.com from always_denied.domains to a new category github_user_content granted to the research profile and host caller hermes (3141); uploads.github.com stays always-denied; add a 'why' comment per remaining always-denied name. Add modes: allowlist (named categories only, no web_public anywhere), research (today + github_user_content), open (research + web_public for agent-llm AND catalog, because they share the llm pool and the renderer refuses pool-mates with different categories - VERIFICATION.md CR-002 note); fetch and validate never get web_public in any mode; gatekeeper/runner host_callers identical in every mode (a renderer assertion, not data). Mode state: config default egress.yaml 'mode_default: open' via the snapshot, the active mode in /var/lib/ossbot/control/egress-mode (JSON {mode, actor, ts}; gatekeeper:osscontrol; unparseable -> allowlist, fail closed). Changing it: Telegram /egress <mode> (go: two-tap confirm) and 'ossctl egress mode <mode>' (TTY confirm) -> gatekeeper writes the flag, audits, FYIs -> root systemd/ossbot-egress.path + ossbot-egress-apply.service -> scripts/bin/ossbot-egress-apply re-renders squid via ossbot.ctl.render for the snapshot + mode and reconfigures the proxy container; 'ossbot-firewall --check' / watchdog compare the running squid conf with the render for the current mode. Update the squid golden(s) per mode (tests/unit/ctl/golden/squid.<mode>.conf), tests/unit/ctl/test_render.py (every mode: invariants identical; fetch/validate never web_public; agent-llm web_public only in open), and tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh (hermes raw CONNECT to x.github.io./gist.github.com. now 200-class through 3141 in research/open; code-running profiles still 403) plus a new tests/sandbox case: research profile 200 on a known *.github.io page and a public gist (raw too), fetch/validate/agent-llm(non-open) 403. Update DESIGN §11.3 and the ADR-0005 addendum (CR-002 wins).

Item 24: Token and approval core deltas 1–9 and the decision services (DESIGN §14.18.4, §14.18.2; rows TGRW-1…TGRW-7, CR3-BA-1, BA-3, BA-4, BA-5, BA-17, CR3-AC-29, AC-31, AC-46, AC-47, AC-57, AC-58, CR3-S1, ADR-0003/0004/0008). `approvals.py`: `DECISION_PURPOSES`, `card_purposes(kind, has_interdiff)` with multi-use view tokens (delta 3), `disarm_expired()` (delta 2), `create(…, expires_at=)`, `reissue(cid, *, tg_chat_id, actor, part_count, keep_expiry=False)` + `reissue_eligible()` and the confirmed-sibling refusal (deltas 5, 7), `Invalidated` with optional `action_id`/`cid`. New `decisions.py` (`DecisionService` protocol, `DecisionServices.for_id/all`), `proposal_approvals.py` and `skill_approvals.py` (ids `p_…`/`s_…` via `common/ids.py`, two-tap, single-use, message-bound, binding hashes recomputed before the effect; content fields filled by FEAT-006/007) over migration `0002_decisions.sql` (tables `proposal_approvals`, `skill_approvals`, `tg_views`, `tg_thread_seq`, the new `ui_tokens`/`tg_outbox` columns of §14.20.2). `context.py`: `reissue`, `reissue_proposal`, `reissue_skill`, `card_recover`. `app.housekeeping_once`: `expire_due` + `disarm_expired` on every service, then `card_recover`. Kill (four sites in `control.py`) and reload (`config_snapshot.py`) fan out over `ctx.decisions.all()` (delta 9). `outbox.mark_sent(row, result)` binds tokens and writes `tg_views` in one transaction (delta 6); `CardPublisher` dispatches through `ctx.decisions.for_id` and has `recover()` (delta 8). `state_machine.sweep_expired` uses the newest approval's window start and cancels pending actions. Files: `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/{approvals.py,decisions.py,proposal_approvals.py,skill_approvals.py,context.py,app.py,control.py,config_snapshot.py,outbox.py,state_machine.py}`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/bot.py`, `src/ossbot/common/ids.py`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/migrations/0002_decisions.sql`, `tests/unit/gatekeeper/{test_approvals.py,test_reissue_part_counts.py,test_reissue_eligibility.py,test_decision_fanout.py,test_card_recover.py,test_dedupe_keys.py,test_outbox.py}` Verify: `DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram"` green, including the BA-1 AST test, kill and reload invalidating all three services, expiry kept on re-send (AC 46), crash between `mark_sent` and `on_sent` healed (AC 31); every existing Phase 1 approval test still passes.

Item 25: Update-handler budget and the redaction choke point (DESIGN §14.18.5, §14.9 U14, §14.3 amendment; rows TGRW-5, TGRW-8 server part, TGRW-11, CR3-BA-2, BA-15, BA-16, BA-18, BA-21, CR3-AC-15, AC-59, AC-66 core part, AC-67, CR3-U14, P1-4). `telegram/handlers.py`: `spawn(coro, kind, *, session_key, on_done)`, `cancel(kinds)`, `KILL_CANCELS`, the session map with one done callback, `PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_S = 8.0`, `HANDLER_SLOW_S = 1.0`, `_run_submit` and every I/O-bound command/confirm effect through `spawn`; registry `effect: local|io`. New `gatekeeper/secret_scan.py` (`SecretScanner`, one per snapshot on `AppContext`), `policy.check_text(…, *, secret_values)` with every production caller passing them (AST test), packaging scans the patch; new `telegram/ui/redact.py` (`redact`, `scan`, `draft_visible`). P1-4: `ApprovalService.set_text_override` runs `policy.check_text` (title single line 1–256, body ≤ 60 000, disclosure, confidentiality floor, secrets) and refuses before storing anything. A fake Hermes stream (`tests/fakes/fake_hermes.py`, minimal) is used for the budget tests. Files: `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/{handlers.py,commands/registry.py}`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/{secret_scan.py,policy.py,packaging.py,approvals.py}`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/ui/{__init__.py,redact.py}`, `tests/fakes/fake_hermes.py`, `tests/telegram/test_handlers_nonblocking.py`, `tests/unit/gatekeeper/{test_secret_scan.py,test_redaction_paths.py,test_approvals.py}` Verify: `DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram"` green (typed `/kill` handled ≤ 2 s with a 60 s fake stream held open, no `handler_slow` log, cancel-before-start batch, secret split across deltas never shown by `draft_visible`, edited title with a newline or a floor value refused and nothing stored).

Item 26: Round-6 NITs and the no-exposure guard (rows P1-16, P1-17, P1-19, CR3-CF-1, DES-AC-42, CHAT-33, ADR-0013). P1-16: `hyperv-firewall.ps1` requires exactly the two ossbot rules (Outbound, Allow, Enabled, TCP, 443/80) and re-creates drifted ones; `ossctl.ps1 doctor` validates properties and flags other Allow rules for the WSL VMCreatorId. P1-17: `tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py` asserts `ProtectHome` ∈ {yes, tmpfs} for every non-root unit; `test_egress_surface.sh` and doctor assert `Linger=no` and no `/run/user/<uid>` for the service uids; VERIFICATION threat-table row 41. P1-19: the surface test arms a root `systemd-run --on-active=90` dead-man job that restores `kernel.io_uring_disabled=2` and starts the watchdog timer, cancelled after the restore. No exposure: `tests/system/test_no_exposure.sh` (no non-loopback TCP/UDP listener in the distro except documented container bridges with no published ports; `ss -ltnup` parsed) and `tests/unit/test_no_tunnels.py` (no `cloudflared`, `ngrok`, `tailscale funnel`/`serve`, webhook URL or tunnel config in the repo, Dockerfiles, compose, provisioning or units). Files: `scripts/{hyperv-firewall.ps1,ossctl.ps1}`, `tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py`, `tests/system/{test_egress_surface.sh,test_no_exposure.sh}`, `tests/unit/test_no_tunnels.py`, `src/ossbot/ctl/doctor.py`, `docs/VERIFICATION.md` Verify: `DEV pytest -m unit tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py tests/unit/test_no_tunnels.py` green; `ROOT bash tests/system/test_no_exposure.sh` and `ROOT bash tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh` green; `powershell -NoProfile -File scripts\ossctl.ps1 doctor` PASS for Hyper-V. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 25: Phase 1 review round 6 NITs (docs/review-phase1.json): P1-15 add ::/128 (and ::ffff:0:0/96 as documentation) to always_denied.cidrs + squid goldens; P1-16 hyperv-firewall.ps1 requires exactly the two ossbot rules (Outbound, Allow, Enabled, TCP, 443/80) and re-creates drifted ones, ossctl.ps1 doctor validates properties and flags other Allow rules for the WSL VMCreatorId; P1-17 tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py asserts ProtectHome in {yes,tmpfs} for every non-root unit, test_egress_surface.sh and doctor assert Linger=no and no /run/user/<uid> for the five service uids, VERIFICATION threat-table row 41 updated; P1-18 reword threat-table rows 7/36 (research pool and Hermes hold a Kiro key + web_public; controls = ADR-0017 key out of tool reach + output key scans; CR-002 open adds agent-llm); P1-19 test_egress_surface.sh arms a root 'systemd-run --on-active=90' dead-man job restoring kernel.io_uring_disabled=2 and starting the watchdog timer before the sysctl write, cancelled after the restore. Then redeploy, run the FEAT verification, set status completed, write findings (blocker/hook observations, backup include list, anything the docs need), commit locally.
